description: This file defines the ShareAccountDividendData class, which is a data container for dividend information related to share accounts in the Fineract project. It includes fields such as dividend ID, posting date, associated account data, amount, status, and associated transaction ID.

classes.name: ShareAccountDividendData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing dividend details for a share account, including IDs, monetary amount, status, and associated transaction information.

methods.name: ShareAccountDividendData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize dividend data with ID, account data, amount, status, and transaction ID.
